title: Unit Event — Backlight, Lens Flare — Episode6 No End In Sight

meta.Event Outline: Wonderlands×Showtime's next step is to appear as extras in a film! Each of them is enthusiastic about this opportunity to work their magic on camera, and Rui is particularly eager to learn about a different type of directing. However, not everything goes smoothly...

rows.Line: A few hours later
Beach

rows.Speaker: Crew Member
rows.Line:
That's everything for today's shoot!
We'll be starting tomorrow morning around seven, so I'll see you all bright and early!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Phew...
We somehow managed to get through the second half of the day.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Nice work, you guys!
Your beach shoot went so well☆>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, and Bakuno did an excellent job of switching gears. Mr. Ohara sounded very happy about what we took.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, he did!
A lot of the scenes we covered today involved complex sets of emotions, but he just kept on being an amazing actor.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, Bakuno was so good!
I love how he's able to jump between completely unrelated scenes like it's no problem!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But we still have to keep doing our best tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Not only do we have an early start, but we're doing that one scene again in the afternoon...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <You mean the climax scene you did during the day?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<That looked really hard.
I sure hope things go better tomorrow...>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Me too...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh...
There's Bakuno right on cue.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
Oh, hello...
Nice work today, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We should be the ones telling you that. You had quite a long day. How are you feeling?

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm actually okay.
My usual rehearsals run from morning until evening anyway.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
Still...
Adapting to a new situation isn't easy.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Bakuno...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: How about we go somewhere to take your mind off things? We haven't had dinner yet, so if you'd like to join us...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, Rui, nice idea!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I read that the roast beef at the hotel we're staying at is supposed to be super yummy! I've really been looking forward to trying it♪

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Oh, that sounds nice!

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
Unfortunately...
I'll have to pass.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: I still need to figure out what to do for tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
I hope you all have a nice dinner.
You can tell me all about it tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
Anyway, I'll be going now.
Have a nice evening, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: There he goes.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I guess he's worried about that scene.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'd rather he didn't beat himself up over it...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I've given that scene some thought since then, but I'm struggling to come up with an answer.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Even after talking with Mr. Ohara about changing camera angles or reworking certain shots, nothing really stood out.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (What are we missing? What are we not see—)

rows.Speaker: Crew Member
rows.Line: Are you not having dinner, sir?

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line:
No, I'm okay.
I need to start editing that scene right now, so don't call me unless it's an emergency.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: He isn't having dinner because of that scene...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Sorry, everyone.
I need to go as well.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: R-Rui?!
Several dozen minutes later
Work Area

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: I've tried switching things around, but the shots we've been using don't seem to be the issue.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Right... It seems that the feel of this scene remains the same regardless of which ones we use.

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line:
Exactly.
Plus, I'd like to avoid fixing anything in this scene that doesn't actually need fixing...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I agree.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The characters in this scene undergo some big changes emotionally, so it seems best to keep things simple and let the focus be on the actors' performances.

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: Hey, you're really starting to get the hang of things.

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line:
Anyway, you should go.
We have to get started early tomorrow, so head back to the hotel and eat some—
Oh, look at you working in another cramped little setup.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh...?

Doing another low-budget film?
What is it with you and those, Tomomi?

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line:
Hey, this isn't my choice!
Also, what are you doing here?! How did you find out where I was?!

Your crew tipped us off.
I was in the neighborhood, so I decided to pay you a visit.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(Are they friends or something...?
They seem to know each other pretty well...)

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line:
Oh, Kamishiro, let me introduce you.
This is my friend from my university days that I just can't seem to get rid of.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
It's nice to meet you.
My name is Rui Kamishiro. I'm working as Mr. Ohara's assistant.

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: One thing led to another and I ended up taking him on. He's also a theatre director.
Hey, that's pretty cool considering how young you are.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Wait... “Also”?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Is he also a theatre director...?)

Hey, is this the film you're working on?
Looks like another snooze fest.

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line:
Shut up.
And quit touching my stuff.

rows.Speaker: Katsuyuki
rows.Line:
“H-How can you say that...?
You show up out of nowhere, mess with my feelings and...”

rows.Speaker: Katsuyuki
rows.Line: “The truth is, I don't care about what's really going on with you... I just...!”

Hey, is that Reki Bakuno?
That's a nice catch. Won't this be his first film?

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: Hey, don't start playing it...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (He's rather assertive.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But I suppose it only makes sense that Mr. Ohara's friend would have a similar personality.)

rows.Speaker: Hajime
rows.Line: “I'm sorry.”
se_run_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Katsuyuki
rows.Line: “Hajime, wait!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Huh?)

rows.Speaker: Katsuyuki
rows.Line:
“...
I'm guessing that's not even your real name.”

rows.Speaker: Katsuyuki
rows.Line: “I still don't know anything about you.”

rows.Speaker: Katsuyuki
rows.Line: “Absolutely nothing...”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(What happened there?
His expression suddenly changed...)
So, is this scene all finished?

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line:
No, not yet.
It's still bugging me a lot.

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: I thought it had something to do with Bakuno's acting at first, but doing more takes didn't make the problem go away. I'm starting to think that it's the cinematography that needs fixing...
Hmm...

Yeah, I can see why.
You'd never let anything like this see the light of day, Tomomi.

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: How many times do I have to tell you to not call me by my first name?

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: Anyway, how would you fix this...?

Hmm... Well...
If it were up to me...
I'd try to rethink this scene with Reki Bakuno in mind.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Rethink it...with him in mind?)

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: What? The film itself wouldn't exist in the first place without Bakuno. Right from day one, we...

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line:
No, wait.
What if I—

Alright, there's no need to panic.
I was just giving you my two cents.
I mean, Tomomi, this is one of your films we're talking about. I'm sure it's gonna be fine in the end.

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: Empty reassurances as usual...
Anyway, I've got an after-party to attend. I'll drop in some other time.

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line:
Wait, hey!
Let me know you're coming next time!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “Rethink it with him in mind”...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But Mr. Ohara said himself that the film wouldn't exist without Bakuno, and that he specifically wanted him to play the protagonist.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Which means it's been created with him in mind right since the planning stage...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(But that expression...
He must've seen something...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Something that we're still missing.)
